# Google Accounts

> > Google Accounts is the central authentication and account management system for Google services, governed by comprehensive terms of service and privacy policies.

Google Accounts (accounts.google.com) serves as the primary identity and access management platform for Google LLC, a Delaware corporation. This site handles user account agreements, privacy documentation, and service terms that apply across Google's ecosystem of products and services.

## Key Topics

- Google Account
- Google LLC
- Terms of Service
- Privacy Policy
- Account Agreement
- User Rights
- Service Terms
- Google Services
- Legal Agreement
- Delaware
- United States

## Legal & Terms

- [Google Terms of Service](https://accounts.google.com/TOS): Google Terms of Service and account agreement for Google LLC governing user rights and service terms
